caption: The drawing is an embroidered sampler on a rectangular piece of light tan fabric. It is bordered by a floral design of interconnected pink and green flowers with a thin blue inner edge. The top section contains five rows of stitched capital and lowercase alphabets and numbers in dark brown and black thread. The bottom section features text in large, stitched cursive and block letters reading "Eunice W Cook's Sampler Wrought in the 10th year of her age A D 1813." Below the text, there are five stylized green trees evenly spaced, with a gold or yellow basket or urn in the center. The threads used are mostly shades of green, pink, gold, and black, with careful alignment and symmetry throughout the composition.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
